buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA The bids submitted by sellers to whom LTE has been issued shall only be considered for evaluation. Bids fr om other sellers shall be treated as unsolicited bids in the instant procurement case and will not be consid ered. However, bids submitted by authorized dealers of the invited manufacturers shall be considered, provided they submit a valid authorization letter from the respective manufacturer who has been specifically invited against this bid. The authorization letter must clearly confirm the dealer’s authority to bid on behalf of the manufacturer for this tender. Firms interested in registration as sellers with SAIL shall fill the vendor registration form hosted on the SAI L Tenders website (www.sailtenders.co.in) and complete the due process of registration with SAIL Plants/U nits. The standard registration process of SAIL-RSP shall thereafter be followed to assess and register eligib le suppliers. This information is provided solely to explore the possibility of expanding the vendor base, where required,

and shall not be construed as a purchase enquiry. Future purchase enquiries may be issued to such suppli ers if they are successfully registered. REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION TUBE FOR RECIRCULATION COOLER-A, SPRAY SATURATOR, CCD-1. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Tubes shall be straight and of fixed length. Tolerance shall be as per BS 3059/87 (Part-1). 2. Tubes shall be oiled on inside and outside surfaces. 3. Each tube shall be marked with the following: a) BS 3059/1987/PART-1/SEAMLESS/320. b) Size: 38 mm OD × 2.6 mm WT × 2800 mm long. c) Monogram of the supplier/manufacturer. DELIVERY REQUIREMENT Within 120 days after PO placement. GUARANTEE CLAUSE Supplier shall furnish a guarantee for 12 months from the date of commissioning or 18 months from the da te of dispatch, whichever is earlier, covering workmanship and trouble-free operation. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE Firm till delivery. PACKAGING CLAUSE Suitable packing shall be provided to avoid any damage during transit. INSPECTION AGENCY Manager (MM), INS. INSPECTION TERM Inspection: By Manager (INS), MM. Certificates: Guarantee Certificate and Material Test Certificate. PLACE OF INSPECTION At Stores, RSP. BIDDERS TO NOTE 1. Bidder must submit duly filled Annexure-A, Annexure-B (Format for undertaking by the bidder) and Anne xure-S (Details of supporting documents for verification), along with the offer. Formats are attached in the bid document. 2. Offers of bidder(s) whose performance in SAIL-Rourkela Steel Plant (RSP) has been found unsatisfactory may not be considered. SAIL-RSP reserves the right to summarily reject such offers at any stage of tender, including after price discovery. 3. In case any adverse report is received against a tenderer, either as information or upon enquiry made b y SAIL, regarding the capabilities and performance of the tenderer after receipt of the tender (even after o pening of the price bid), the quotation/tender submitted by such tenderer shall be liable to be rejected on the grounds of such adverse report(s). 4. Verification of Supporting Documents:

i) SAIL reserves the right to verify any supporting document(s) submitted by a participating tenderer/bid der from the source (document issuing authority). ii) In the interest of expeditious completion of verification, participating tenderer/bidder shall provide a li st of each supporting document on its letterhead as per Annexure-S, along with contract details (postal ad dress, email address, landline/mobile number) of the issuing authority of each supporting document for ver ification. iii) Non-verification of any supporting document or information, at the sole discretion of SAIL, does not ab solve the tenderer/bidder of its absolute responsibility to provide only genuine document(s) in support of el igibility conditions. iv) If any supporting document or information is found to be fake/forged/tampered/non-genuine at any st age during tendering process or even after placement of purchase order/work order, the tenderer/bidder s hall be liable for punitive actions as per extant guidelines of SAIL. 5. OTHER TERMS i. No deviations are acceptable. By submitting an offer against this bid, the bidder accepts all terms and co nditions of the bid as well as GeM terms and conditions. ii. All prices quoted in GeM shall be on landed cost basis, inclusive of GST and all taxes/duties, unless other wise specified in the Special Terms of ATC. iii. Bidders are requested to update the firm’s GST registration status prior to participating in the bid. Since all prices quoted in GeM are on landed cost basis, inclusive of GST and all taxes/duties, the case shall be e valuated accordingly. iv. Only relevant document(s) shall be uploaded for technical and commercial scrutiny. Submission of addit ional documents beyond the requirement shall not be taken cognizance of. By participating in the bid, the bidder agrees to comply with all terms and conditions without any alteration, addition or modification. Any attempt to include additional terms or clauses in the bid document may result in rejection of the bid at any stage. The Buyer reserves the right to take appropriate action, including but not limited to disqualification of the bidder, cancellation of the bid and cancellation of the order, at its sole discretion. v. Bidders shall compulsorily submit duly filled annexures, bearing stamp and signature of the authorized r epresentative, as part of the online offer. vi. Any technical query/clarification shall be routed through the pre-bid representation functionality availab le against this bid. vii. Risk Purchase (RPN) Clause: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, if the Supplier negl ects or fails to perform the Agreement by the time(s) agreed upon, for any reason other than Force Majeur e, the Purchaser, upon becoming aware of such negligence or non-performance, shall give 14 to 30 days’ notice or such extended period as may be mutually agreed between the Supplier and Purchaser to rectify t he default. Thereafter, the Purchaser may take such action as it considers fit, including but not limited to ri sk purchase action for supply of the material, mitigating any losses, at the risk and cost of the Supplier, as far as the undelivered quantity in that Delivery Period is concerned. The Purchaser’s right to risk purchase action is in addition to its right to terminate the Contract due to the Supplier’s fault. Any price differential i n case of higher cost to SAIL shall be borne by the defaulting Supplier. The defaulting Supplier shall have n o claim over the quantity which it failed to supply. viii. Before dispatching the material, seller(s) must ensure the following: a) GeM contract is duly accepted. b) GeM fees, if any, for contract acceptance have been paid. c) GeM contract remains valid till receipt of material at consignee location. d) Invoices have been created in GeM, confirming dispatch of material. ix. SAIL-RSP shall place back-up order(s) against GeM contract(s) on successful bidder(s). SAIL-RSP’s back- up purchase order shall, however, be released only after acceptance of the contract by the seller in GeM. T he concerned bidder shall mention the back-up order number in the invoices for proper accounting of mat erial upon receipt in RSP. x. Non-compliance with the requisites under clauses viii and ix shall be at the vendor’s risk, and any delay(
s) arising out of such non-compliance shall be on the vendor’s account. PR - 2623000091 . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
